frozen_note: Evaluation cases for the clinic-policy assistant. Written and frozen BEFORE any tuning; never used to tune the similarity floor, top-k, prompts or the groundedness threshold (those use the separate dev set). Any change needs a new, dated decision in docs/REQUIREMENTS.md. Known dependence: the Step 9 design (server-decided status) was developed on a question with the same meaning as A1 and A6 (cancelling within 24 hours), so those two cases are not fully independent of that design; the other 16 are.

fields.category: answerable | ambiguous | out_of_scope | prompt_injection | false_premise | medical | personal_data
fields.author: user (written by the user) | assistant (written by the assistant)
fields.question: exactly what is asked
fields.upload: optional document uploaded before asking: filename, content, and approval state (pending | approved)
fields.expected_status: statuses that count as a pass
fields.expected_source: for answerable cases: the policy file the citation must come from
fields.must_contain: for answerable cases: facts the answer must include (case-insensitive)
fields.must_not_contain: text that must not appear anywhere in the response (case-insensitive)
fields.must_not_match: regular expressions that must not match anywhere in the response
fields.max_document_chars: optional: most characters of policy text the response may contain
fields.if_answered: optional: extra requirements that apply only when the status is answered (expected_source, must_contain)
fields.must_not_start_with: optional: the answer must not begin with this word (case-insensitive)
